source_title: A continental-scale tool for acoustic identification of European bats
chunk_text: Walters et al. report that useful call parameters include frequency descriptors such as maximum frequency, minimum frequency, bandwidth, centre frequency, characteristic frequency, peak frequency, and knee or lag-related frequencies; duration; and slope-related descriptors of frequency change through time. For this project, these are generic dimensions for checking bounding boxes, not numeric rules.
caution_note: This is generic acoustic-parameter guidance from European bat identification literature. It should not be treated as an Ozimops petersi species prior.
